overview.Name: Sun Communities, Inc.
overview.Description: Sun Communities, Inc. became a publicly owned corporation in December 1993. The Company is a fully integrated REIT listed on the New York Stock Exchange. As of March 31, 2026, the Company owned, operated, or had an interest in a portfolio of 515 developed MH, RV, and UK properties comprising approximately 179,300 developed sites in the U.S., Canada, and the U.K. Sun Communities, Inc. was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Southfield, United States.
